title: Bioinformatics Analysis to Reveal Potential Targets of Huntington's Disease.
authors: Yang, Shu; Xu, Xinjie; Liu, Weida; Zhang, Shuyang
one_liner_zh: 该研究通过机器学习、孟德尔随机化和单细胞测序分析亨廷顿病转录组，虽涉及转录因子SOX4和ETV1的鉴定，但缺乏蛋白质-DNA互作建模或AI/物理模拟方法，与本课题核心关联较弱。
abstract: Huntington's disease (HD) is a progressive neurodegenerative disease resulted from the expansion of CAG repeats in huntingtin (HTT) gene and characterised by motor impairment, psychiatric disorders and cognitive decline. Currently, there are no available disease-modifying treatments. In this study, we performed an integrative analysis of HD datasets downloaded from the Gene Expression Omnibus (GEO) database using machine learning approaches, Mendelian randomisation (MR) and single cell RNA-sequencing (scRNA-seq) analysis to elucidate underlying disease mechanisms. The machine learning algorithms of LASSO, random forest and SVM-RFE identified the decreased ADRA2A in HD. In addition, MR analysis revealed HD-associated proteins such as LILRA4 and UBE2D1, associated with immune response and ubiquitination metabolism, respectively. scRNA-seq analysis further identified the transcription factors of SOX4 and ETV1 through SCENIC analysis. Pseudotime trajectory analysis highlighted heparan sulphate sulfotransferase activity, involving genes CHST11, HS3ST3A1 and HS6ST3 that drive cell differentiation. Moreover, cell-cell communication analysis demonstrated enhanced NRG1/3-ERBB4 signalling pathway in HD. This study presents multiple potential targets for HD treatment but further experimental validation is required to confirm their functional relevance.
abstract_zh: 亨廷顿病（Huntington's disease, HD）是一种进行性神经退行性疾病，由亨廷顿（huntingtin, HTT）基因中CAG重复序列的扩增引起，其特征为运动障碍、精神疾病和认知衰退。目前尚无改善疾病的治疗方法。在本研究中，我们利用机器学习方法、孟德尔随机化（Mendelian randomisation, MR）和单细胞RNA测序（single cell RNA-sequencing, scRNA-seq）分析，对从基因表达综合数据库（Gene Expression Omnibus, GEO）下载的HD数据集进行了整合分析，以阐明潜在的疾病机制。LASSO、随机森林和SVM-RFE的机器学习算法识别出HD中ADRA2A的降低。此外，MR分析揭示了与HD相关的蛋白质，如LILRA4和UBE2D1，分别与免疫反应和泛素化代谢相关。scRNA-seq分析进一步通过SCENIC分析识别出转录因子SOX4和ETV1。伪时间轨迹分析强调了硫酸乙酰肝素磺基转移酶活性，涉及驱动细胞分化的基因CHST11、HS3ST3A1和HS6ST3。此外，细胞间通讯分析显示HD中NRG1/3-ERBB4信号通路增强。本研究为HD治疗提供了多个潜在靶点，但需进一步的实验验证以确认其功能相关性。
